baseline.note: Stale-hash rows are not countable in SQL (hash is computed over the record's current embedding text in JS); they surface as embedded counts during the run and are proven zero at the end by the all-fresh verification sweep.

postRun1Snapshot.note: The drain added ~1,438 listed records during run 1 (6,481 → 7,919); the 313 without meta are its late additions. The VM restart also killed the drain process; it was not relaunched by this task (its resume command is recorded in data/gate-backfill.txt), so the catalog was static during run 2.

run1.contention: Repeated HTTP 500 D1_ERROR 'Currently processing a long-running import' + one D1_RESET_DO from the concurrent drain's wrangler --file flushes — all absorbed by backoff; one page-size halving (200 → 100). No page ever skipped: the cursor only advances on HTTP 200.
run1.gaveUp: Sweep 2, page 101 (cursor eyadsibai/k8s-lessons): 40 consecutive network-level 'fetch failed' attempts exhausted the retry budget; driver exited 1 by design. The sandbox VM then restarted (~05:20Z), wiping /tmp (admin token + run log) — the same incident class as the backfill run's 03:29Z restart. Zero coverage lost: embedding_meta in D1 is the checkpoint.

run2.result: Sweep 1 embedded exactly the 313-record remainder; sweep 2 (full re-verification) considered all 7,919 listed records and embedded 0 — every record's stored hash matches its current text under the current model. Converged; driver exited 0.

catchUp.smokeProbe: First paged call (no body): considered=100, embedded=31, skippedFresh=69, nextCursor returned, done=false — bounded behavior verified live before the run.

change.implementation: src/discovery/embeddings.ts indexStaleRecordsPage (reuses indexStaleRecords — same text-hash + model staleness rule, same vector keying: vector id = sha256(record id), mapped in embedding_meta.vector_id, Workers AI @cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5); cf/src/db.ts recordsPage (SQL-paged fetch, id > cursor); cf/src/discovery.ts handleAdminEmbed wired to both; scripts/backfill-embed.mjs rewritten to thread the cursor with backoff, page-halving under repeated failure, and repeat straggler sweeps.
change.route: POST /admin/embed now accepts {limit, cursor} and processes ONE bounded page per call (default 100, max 500), ordered by record id, returning {considered, embedded, skippedFresh, nextCursor, done}. A no-body call processes only the first bounded page — the all-records scan is gone.

final.listedCoverage: 100% of listed records carry an embedding_meta row, and the final verification sweep proves every one is fresh (text hash + model current). Meta rows exceed listed by 50 — rows for records no longer listed, unchanged from baseline.
final.remainder: None at final measurement. New records ingested after this gate (cron/queue/webhook paths) are embedded by the existing ingest hooks; if a future bulk drain outruns them again, scripts/backfill-embed.mjs is the restart-safe catch-up.

finding: dnyoussef/agentdb-semantic-vector-search (also embedded by run 1; vector_id present and mapped) is NOT reachable by meaning-only paraphrase because its stored description is literally '---' — a frontmatter-extraction artifact in its source record, so its embedding text is dominated by its name tokens. This is a source-record data-quality issue in one code-search ingest batch, not an embeddings-coverage gap; the record is embedded and reachable via its content tokens. Flagged for the parent; fixing description extraction is ingest work, out of this gate's scope.
